script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Adam, Uncle Omar brought fresh dates. How many do we have for the guests?

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Let's count! One, two, three, four, five... wait, look here!

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Six, seven, eight, nine, ten!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Splendid counting, Adam! Now add the ripe ones: eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Exactly fifteen sweet dates. Beautiful work!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Look at this heritage collection! In this silver tray, we have sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen, twenty ancient coins.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Twenty coins! Are there more in the wooden drawers?

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Yes! They are bundled in sets of ten: thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety!

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: That makes one hundred historic coins!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Indeed! And centuries ago, a thousand merchants traded them across a million desert miles.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Ready for round one of our math quiz, Adam? Let's check the leaderboard.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I solved the first, second, third, fourth, and fifth questions correctly!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Brilliant! Now rank your next answers: sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth, and tenth.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Perfect order. Now calculate the total score using addition and subtraction.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Through quick multiplication and division, the final score equals ten out of ten!

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Uncle Omar, how much is this Arabic calligraphy set?

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The pen is four dollars plus two dollars for the ink, minus a one-dollar discount.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: And if Adam buys three sets, that is five dollars times three!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Divided by three friends, with a twenty percentage bonus discount today!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Look at Uncle Omar's workbench, Adam. The natural ink jars are all laid out.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I see bright red, deep blue, vibrant yellow, and fresh green!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Beside them, we have sweet orange, royal purple, gentle pink, walnut brown, midnight black, and pure white.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And in these glass dishes, there is bright cyan and rich magenta.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: To frame the illuminated page, Omar added zesty lime, ocean teal, and midnight indigo.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Examine these dyed silk threads: delicate violet, warm coral, subtle salmon, and bright turquoise.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: This soft lavender skein smells of dried herbs! Some strands are light, and some are dark.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Notice how the bright yellow stands out against the dull cloth beneath it.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: We pair vivid crimson with pale beige, balancing a deep navy with warm golden amber.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Cool azure and neutral silver bring perfect harmony to the whole carpet design!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Let us mix these powdered lapis stones, Adam. Blend the pigments slowly across the glass plate.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Adding water creates a soft tint, while charcoal powder gives a deeper shade!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Watch closely: each stroke changes the primary hue and enriches the color saturation.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The wet wash forms an elegant gradient across the canvas, like a glowing rainbow over the valley.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Every natural mineral pigment shines across the visible light spectrum!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Look at the wooden shapes on Uncle Omar's workbench, Adam. Let's build the pavilion base.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I have a flat circle, a solid square, a sharp triangle, a long rectangle, and a smooth oval.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Splendid! Now add the tile motifs: a sparkling diamond, a five-sided pentagon, a hexagon, an eight-sided octagon, and a shining star.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Now for the three-dimensional blocks: place the round sphere upon the cube, and the tall cylinder beneath the rooftop cone.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And this miniature step pyramid crowns the entrance courtyard perfectly!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Examine these solid stone carvings: a triangular prism, a rectangular cuboid, a dome hemisphere, a circular torus, and a four-sided tetrahedron.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: With my ruler, I draw a fine pencil line. Is this arch a gentle curve or a straight edge?

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The decorative border alternates between an energetic zigzag and a graceful nautilus spiral.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Check your protractor: ensure the arch base has an exact right angle, this corner has a narrow acute angle, and the roof joint has a wide obtuse angle.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Understood! The column guidelines are strictly parallel, and the support beam is perfectly perpendicular!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Before laying the tiles, Adam, calculate the floor area, outer wall perimeter, and water fountain volume.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: The fountain basin radius is two feet, which makes the diameter four feet, and its round circumference twelve feet.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Notice the diagonal line across each square tile. It preserves fourfold symmetry from every sharp vertex to outer edge.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Now repeat the rhythmic color sequence to expand the interlocking star pattern.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: It forms a flawless geometric tessellation, growing outward like a natural fractal under the sun!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Look at the master floor plan, Adam. The brass wires create an orderly square grid.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Each ceramic tile sits inside an aligned rectangular array, structured like a neat mathematical matrix.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: When morning sunlight shines through, this stained glass mosaic turns the hall into a giant kaleidoscope of color!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: You did it, Adam! We are so proud of you, and deeply grateful for your persistence today.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Thank you! I feel so happy, joyful, and excited tonight, completely content with our presentation.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Your cheerful energy made everyone delighted, and your spinning robot kept the whole crowd amused!

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: This morning I was hopeful, but also scared and worried when the battery failed. I felt sad and frustrated, almost angry for a second!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Yet you stayed calm through the trial, and overcame every obstacle with grace.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: When the train was delayed, some commuters looked disappointed and upset, while others seemed annoyed.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: I felt bored and lonely at first, but sitting quietly kept my heart calm, even though my legs were tired.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I was surprised when the lights flickered and a bit confused by the speaker announcement, but curious to read this old book.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Reading made you thoughtful and relaxed, while those rushing past seemed indifferent to the quiet evening.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I felt sleepy an hour ago, but this fresh cardamom tea has made me sharp and alert!

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: What a journey! Under the midday sun I was sweating and hot, completely thirsty, and now my stomach is hungry.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: At the windy mountain summit, I felt cold and dizzy from the steep trail, slightly nauseous for a moment.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Sit beside the hearth. You were both exhausted, but these wool rugs will make you warm and comfortable.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: After this warm lentil soup and fresh bread, my belly is delightfully full and I feel energetic once more!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Look at our family gallery, Adam. Our gentle mother and hardworking father built this peaceful home.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Mom and Dad are such caring parents! We have our sensible big sister, a younger sister, and you, my older brother.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Tariq is the proud oldest child, and Adam is the energetic little brother! And look here: your aunt holds her sweet baby, alongside her twin boys.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Every son and daughter brings immense light, and all four siblings stand united.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: During our peaceful morning routine, I provide homework help for Adam before school.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Even as the youngest child, I love cooking together before our weekly family dinner, followed by game night and movie night!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: My friend Bilal was an only child, but now his middle child is joining our road trip to the annual holiday gathering.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: His kind stepmother and thoughtful stepfather helped hang the golden family photo, right before grandmother read us a bedtime story.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: A noble family is established upon pure love, steadfast trust, and unwavering mutual support.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Our parents provide daily care, secure protection, and wise moral guidance through every age.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Gentle discipline molds true integrity, while sincere affection enriches the lifelong family bond.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Living by these virtues honors our ancestors and preserves our cherished family heritage.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Adam, time to rise and arrange your bed before morning breakfast.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I will smooth the cotton sheet over the mattress, fluff my pillow, and fold the warm blanket and duvet.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Good morning! Did you leave your notebook on the bedside nightstand or inside the wooden dresser?

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Check your study desk, right beside the wooden chair and tall bookshelf.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I see it in the mirror! It was resting on the stool by the chest of drawers, right beside the clothes wardrobe.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Close the bedroom door, Adam. Let's flip the light switch to turn off the bright ceiling light.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I plugged the brass desk lamp into the wall outlet for a softer glow.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Lower the window blinds and draw the thick curtain to keep the evening chill outside.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: This patterned wool rug feels delightful over the bedroom carpet.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And I placed a fresh pillowcase on each cushion, smoothing the warm comforter across the carved headboard and solid bed frame.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The alarm clock rang right at dawn. The wall clock confirms it is time for morning prayers.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I changed out of my pajamas and stepped into my warm slippers and soft morning robe.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Hang your coat upon a wooden hanger, and place that torn wrapper into the wastebasket.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Water the green plant in the ceramic vase, right beside the family picture frame and calendar.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I will grab a tissue from the tissue box, set my childhood teddy bear beneath the wall poster, and extinguish the scented candle.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Time to pack your sturdy backpack, Adam. Did you remember your study books and reading glasses?

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Yes, and I slid my laptop, slim tablet, wireless headphones, and Bluetooth speaker into the padded sleeves.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Do not leave your mobile phone and its fast battery charger on the counter!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Power off the reading light with its remote control, and set the vintage photo album safely beside mother's carved jewelry box.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: All devices are charged, packed, and ready for our study session!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The plumbing restoration is finished, Adam. Look how the glazed ceramic tiles shine under the lights.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: When I turn the brass faucet at the marble sink, clean water rushes straight down the drain!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Excellent water pressure! The deep soaking bathtub and rain shower both function flawlessly.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The low-flow toilet is installed securely, and this carved cedar cabinet sits beneath the framed mirror.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I will hang our fresh linen towels across the brass towel rack!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Personal cleanliness is part of our faith, Adam. Let us arrange your morning toiletries.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I squeeze herbal toothpaste onto my soft toothbrush and wash with olive oil soap.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Use this moisturizing shampoo and softening conditioner to wash your hair, then dry it with a clean cotton towel.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Style your hair neatly with the wooden comb or hairbrush, and apply soothing almond lotion to your hands.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: A swipe of natural mineral deodorant, and I am completely refreshed for the day!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Let's replenish the bathroom supplies, Adam. Stack the extra rolls of soft toilet paper in the lower drawer.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I placed fluffy cotton balls and each sterile cotton swab in glass jars, right beside my stainless steel nail clipper.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Store the safety razor away from moisture, and coil the electrical cord of the hair dryer neatly.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Check the digital weight scale on the floor, and keep the emergency first aid kit and digital thermometer fully stocked.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I gathered all the used washcloths into the wicker laundry basket!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Step inside, Adam. The chrome shower head has been adjusted for optimal water flow.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I pulled the waterproof shower curtain shut and laid the plush non-slip bath mat across the marble floor.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: On the tiled ledge, you have a ceramic soap dish, a fresh shampoo bottle, and invigorating citrus shower gel.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Look! Little cousin left his cheerful yellow rubber duck beside the textured cotton washcloth.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Here is a warm bath towel to dry off, and a smaller hand towel for the basin.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The desert sun is intense today, Adam. Before heading outdoors, we must protect our skin.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I cleaned my cheeks with gentle face wash, applied nourishing face cream, and coated my lips with beeswax lip balm.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Be sure to spread broad-spectrum sunscreen over your neck and arms, and use aloe body wash after returning.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Remember to clean between your teeth with dental floss, and rinse thoroughly with mint mouthwash.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I washed with antibacterial hand soap, and packed travel hand sanitizer and cooling wet wipes in my pouch!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Put on your rubber gloves, Adam. Fill the wash bucket with warm water and grab the cleaning spray bottle.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I will scrub the tiles with this firm sponge and nylon brush, wipe the mirrors with a microfiber cloth, and clear the glass using the rubber squeegee.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Keep the toilet plunger beside the bowl, flush the toilet after sanitizing, and dispose of each paper tissue responsibly.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Now for your personal routine: wash hands thoroughly, brush teeth with care, and gargle warm salt water.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Finally, I will take a shower, dry off with my towel, comb hair neatly, and apply lotion to stay refreshed!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Good morning, Adam! Fill the electric kettle for green tea, and switch on the drip coffee maker.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I retrieved fresh milk from the refrigerator and frozen mango from the freezer for our smoothie blender!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Drop two sourdough slices into the bread toaster, and warm the spiced lentils inside the microwave.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: On the gas stove, we have a large boiling pot, a seasoned frying pan for eggs, and a small saucepan of hot milk.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Slide this cast-iron pan and the baking tray into the oven, then stack our dirty plates inside the dishwasher!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Tonight we host honored guests! Peel these sweet carrots with the vegetable peeler, and grate fresh ginger on the box grater.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I roll the flatbread dough with this heavy wooden rolling pin, and beat egg yolks using the stainless steel whisk.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The spiced lamb stew cooks tenderly inside the pressure cooker, while fragrant jasmine rice warms inside the ceramic casserole dish and tiered steamer.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Stir-fry the greens in the hot steel wok with a wide spatula, turn the kebabs with kitchen tongs, and roast potatoes in the glass baking dish.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: We serve the rich broth with a soup ladle, and set each place with an elegant dinner knife, fork, and dessert spoon.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Culinary craft requires accuracy, Adam. Set the wide ceramic mixing bowl upon the counter.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I add two cups of flour with this measuring cup, and a precise teaspoon of yeast using the measuring spoon.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Slice the figs on the wooden cutting board, strain the berries in the colander, and open the canned peaches with the can opener.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Use the bottle corkscrew for this artisan grape nectar, and fill the crystal pitcher with iced lemon water.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I set each porcelain plate, soup bowl, drinking glass, and tea cup on its saucer, beside a warm coffee mug and linen dish towel!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Tie your chef apron securely, Adam, and slip on the insulated oven mitt before lifting that scalding tray.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Our crusty golden bread is done! I will spread creamy salted butter over a slice, with a cup of cold milk and a boiled egg.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Wrap the extra loaf in cling film or clear plastic wrap, and seal the warm roast under shiny aluminum foil.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Pack the remaining soup into a glass food container, and deposit all vegetable peels into the kitchen trash can.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I will wipe the counters with a paper towel, wash pots with a soapy sponge and dish soap, and stack plates upon the dish rack!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Masterful cooking comes from seasoning with intention, Adam. Warm the golden cooking oil in the saucepan.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I add a pinch of sea salt, freshly ground black pepper, and a dash of balsamic vinegar to brighten the broth.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Simmer the basmati rice alongside Italian durum pasta, and dust the chicken fillets in organic wheat flour.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Grate savory white cheese over the pasta, and drizzle mountain wildflower honey with a spoonful of raw cane sugar onto the dessert.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: To finish our feast, we have a sweet crisp apple and a cold glass of freshly squeezed pomegranate juice!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Our guests arrive at sunset, Adam. Let us arrange the living room seating with utmost care.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I plumped the velvet cushions on the spacious sofa, set the carved coffee table in the center, and placed this armchair by the marble side table.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: A guest can rest their feet on this leather ottoman, or sit peacefully by the courtyard in grandmother's wooden rocking chair.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The banquet dining table and each dining chair are polished, with an upholstered wooden bench and cushioned stool nearby.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: We dusted the walnut bookshelf, decorated the floating wall shelf, and stored tea services inside the cabinet, sideboard, and TV stand!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Hang your coats upon the entrance coat rack, Adam, and place your outdoor shoes neatly on the tiered shoe rack.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I filed architectural journals in the magazine rack, and showcased grandfather's astrolabe inside the glass display case.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Let's organize the electronics: insert this three-prong plug into the surge-protected power strip, and conceal each cable inside the lower drawer.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The high-speed Wi-Fi router is fully synced, while the acoustic sound bar coordinates with every satellite speaker.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: With this universal remote control, I can power the wide television, legacy DVD player, and interactive game console instantly!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: As evening falls, let's adjust the room's illumination, Adam. Dim the bright ceiling light and admire the crystal chandelier.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I turned on the tall floor lamp by the archway, plugged in the table lamp, and fitted an energy-saving warm light bulb.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: These festive string lights look charming! Light this beeswax candle upon its brass candle holder, beside the ticking wall clock and carved picture frame.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Arrange this velvet cushion upon the couch, and drape the woven throw blanket across the armrest.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Drawing the heavy linen curtain keeps the warmth inside, perfectly cushioning our wool rug and deep parlor carpet.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Wipe your shoes on the coconut-fiber doormat, Adam. The reception room looks truly splendid.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I spread the damask tablecloth across the table, laid each woven placemat, and placed wooden coasters for hot mint tea.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Admire the woven historical tapestry on the wall, beside the oil landscape painting and flourishing indoor plant in its ceramic vase.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: I placed the morning newspaper, a scientific magazine, and this classic history book right beside the family photo frame.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: After dinner, we can play a strategic board game, assemble this thousand-piece jigsaw puzzle, or test memory with playing cards!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Come sit down and relax on the divan, Adam. Connect your mobile phone and tablet to the multi-port charger.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I turned on the warm reading lamp and slipped on my over-ear headphones to listen to music and recite poetry quietly.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Sometimes people watch TV or play games, but nothing matches the joy of sharing tea and having an uplifting chat with family.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: It is wonderful to read a book in tranquility, let your thoughts settle, or take a nap before the night prayer.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: A peaceful sanctuary of warmth, learning, and kinship is the greatest comfort in life!

lessons.name: Fruits 1
lessons.titleEn: The Orchard Basket & Summer Berry Patch

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Look at this bountiful harvest basket from the orchard! Let us slice the fresh fruit for our morning breakfast.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I picked a crisp red apple, a ripe yellow banana, a fragrant orange, and a chilled bunch of sweet green grape clusters.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Let's carve this gigantic chilled watermelon and spiky golden pineapple, beside this aromatic tropical mango, velvety peach, and tender pear.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: In the berry patch, I gathered ripe ruby strawberry baskets, sweet blue blueberry pints, tart red raspberry cups, and juicy wild blackberry branches!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Splendid! We will blend in tart mountain cranberry juice and garnish our dessert with this heirloom green gooseberry.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Welcome to the botanical conservatory, boys! Here we cultivate rare woodland berries and exotic tropical treasures from across the globe.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Look at these unique berries: dark sweet mulberry, plump boysenberry, Brazilian acai berry, tart Scandinavian lingonberry, and dark herbal elderberry!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The tropical canopy is marvelous: golden sliced papaya, a fresh brown coconut, fragrant passion fruit, floral pink guava, and sweet translucent lychee.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Notice this vibrant magenta dragon fruit and five-pointed star fruit, hanging beside this colossal thirty-pound jackfruit!

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: The pungent spiky durian is King of Fruits in Southeast Asia, while this hairy crimson rambutan tastes delightfully sweet!

lessons.name: Fruits 3
lessons.titleEn: The Citrus Grove & Summer Stone Fruits

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The morning breeze through our citrus grove is invigorating. Breathe in the aroma of yellow lemon, zesty lime, and ruby grapefruit.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: These are so easy to peel: sweet tangerine, fragrant mandarin, seedless clementine, and this entire bite-sized kumquat!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Cut open this crimson blood orange, this giant mild pomelo, and this aromatic Japanese yuzu prized by master chefs.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Over on the stone fruit terrace, we have ripe red cherry clusters, juicy dark plum branches, velvety apricot, and smooth nectarine.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And Uncle Omar just harvested this naturally sweet caramel date from the palm grove—a perfect wholesome treat!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: These five fruits carry thousands of years of agricultural heritage across the Mediterranean and desert oases.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I picked a tender honeyed fig straight from the branch, and harvested plump green olive varieties for cold pressing.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: We also have rich buttery avocado packed with healthy fats, and this brilliant autumnal persimmon glowing like sunset.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: And crowned in the center is a magnificent ripe pomegranate, overflowing with glistening ruby arils full of antioxidant goodness!
